messages:
Jules: Quick check-in: we're green to run the staggered price-sheet experiment tomorrow morning (2 waves). Need final sign-off on grandfathering edge-cases and vendor schedule.
Pat: wave details? percentage per wave? timezone?
Jules: wave1 = 7% of active customers global at 00:00 UTC, wave2 = additional 8% after 36h. both shadow only for 72h.
Rina: I pulled cohort and found 4 orgs with overlapping credits + promo coupons that would zero-out charges in ways that could mask deltas. proposing we auto-exclude any org with coupon_flag=true or credit_balance>0.
Marco: vendor note: they need the mapping CSV and webhook test window 24h before run so they can seed their invoice simulator. I'll ping vendor ops.
Legal Ops: confirm we must retain all simulated invoice artifacts for 180 days and mark them as 'simulated' in metadata. Also require escalation flow if a simulated delta triggers a customer dispute.
billing-bot: Ticket FIN-1533 created: "staggered-price-experiment-waves" assigned: Rina, Marco. https://tickets.redwood/FIN-1533
Pat: gating checklist draft: 1) cohort export + exclusions 2) top-30 invoice parity check 3) vendor webhook smoke tests 4) audit log retention policy set 5) auto-exclude rule implemented 6) rollback automation configured
Jules: rollback automation spec: if >1% of wave orgs see invoice delta >15% OR any enterprise org delta >$300, pause rollout and notify #incidents + execs.
Rina: ran top-30 parity: 30 checked, 3 flagged (2 coupons, 1 tax-region mismatch). pushing exclude_list.csv to FIN-1533.
Marco: vendor confirmed webhook window and will run webhook retries/backfill test at 18:00 UTC today.
Pat: automation request: can we emit a simulated-customer-email in wave2 only so product can validate messaging? Marked as "simulated" to customers. Need CS heads on watch.
Jules: agree. product/CS heads notified.
Legal Ops: also require manual approval if any org in sample has legacy_contract_clause=true.
Rina: adding a quick SQL for audit export to the ticket:
```
SELECT org_id, event_type, old_amount, new_amount, reason FROM billing.sim_audit WHERE run_id='staggered-1993' ORDER BY org_id;
```
Pat: final preflight 30m before run. thanks everyone. :rocket:
